stages.video_relevance: the source video is about the right event, subject, conflict and context
stages.moment_relevance: the cut segment shows what the narration line describes
stages.visual_usability: the frames are usable footage (no studio graphics, tickers, end screens, presenters, burnt captions, watermarks)
stages.no_arbitrary_fill: an empty scene is never filled with footage from elsewhere in the documentary
stages.subject_discovery: a line without a place name still gets footage of its section's subject
stages.number_semantics: a figure card only for a real quantity with a clear meaning
stages.keyword_fallback: no keyword card built from random words
stages.kinetic_fragment: kinetic text is a complete line
stages.card_complete: every card shows complete content, in sync with its line
stages.overlap: no text layer on top of another, no panel over footage it obscures
stages.map_inherited_place: a map shows only places its own line names
stages.map_framing: a map has a readable scope (borders, labels, land)
stages.map_territory: occupied areas drawn from sourced data (separate stage, needs owner approval)
